◈

FleetWatch

STELLAR TESTNET

Inspect the executable code used by a Soroban contract fleet. Live Testnet reads and typed XDR decoding run in your browser. No server, account, wallet or key is needed.

Foreground observer: updates run while this page is open and visible. Changes between reads can be missed. Source authentication and history coverage remain unverified; this page cannot declare a contract safe or an upgrade approved.

Your watchlist

Starts with the two FleetWatch Testnet demonstration contracts. Testnet data can expire or reset.

—RPC response ledger
—contracts observed

No observation collected yet.

Observed executable values

Current values will appear here after the first read.

Evidence and coverage

Current state only · source UNVERIFIED · history UNKNOWN · verdict UNDETERMINED

External-reference resolution uses multiple RPC calls. Equal response ledger numbers do not prove an atomic observation.
Full capture JSON
No capture yet.
Read-only HTTPS endpoint: https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org · Session observations are held in memory; download evidence to keep it. Closing the page stops observation. No transaction signing, external notifications or unattended monitoring.
